stories.title: Appeals Court Provides Trump Opportunity to Challenge Hush Money Conviction
stories.summary: A federal appeals court has ruled that Donald Trump can seek to move his hush money conviction case to federal court. The court found that a lower judge made an error in determining that Trump had delayed too long in raising his presidential immunity defense. If the case is moved, Trump could argue for the dismissal of the charges based on this immunity.

stories.title: Jensen Huang Returns as Nvidia CEO Following Controversial Resignation
stories.summary: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as its President and CEO, just days after he resigned amid allegations of extramarital affairs and connections to a Chinese intelligence asset. The board's decision, influenced by advocacy from US President Donald Trump, has led to a significant surge in Nvidia's stock price. Huang's return has sparked discussions about potential investigations into the circumstances surrounding his resignation.

stories.title: FIFA Announces Co-hosts for 2031 Women's World Cup
stories.summary: FIFA has confirmed that the 2031 Women's World Cup will be co-hosted by the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica, and Jamaica. This tournament will be notable as it will feature 48 teams for the first time. Additionally, the United Kingdom has been selected to host the 2035 Women's World Cup.

stories.title: U.S. Places Megaspeed on Trade Blacklist Amid Nvidia Scandal
stories.summary: The U.S. government has added Megaspeed to its trade blacklist, citing the firm's alleged connections to espionage and its role in the Nvidia scandal. This decision follows scrutiny over the company's ties to China and its controlling shareholder, Alice Huang, who has been implicated in an espionage investigation. The announcement coincided with the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia.

stories.title: Libya's Eastern Authorities Request UN Investigation into Ukrainian Military Presence Amid Naval Strikes
stories.summary: Authorities in eastern Libya have called for a United Nations investigation into claims of Ukrainian military presence in the west of the country. This follows Ukrainian strikes on two Russian vessels off the coast of Benghazi, which Ukrainian President Zelensky confirmed were executed by Ukrainian forces. Naval forces in eastern Libya are on high alert in response to these developments.

stories.title: Iranian Singer and Concert Team Flogged for Performing Without Hijab
stories.summary: Iranian singer Parastoo Ahmadi and four members of her concert team received 74 lashes each for performing without a hijab during a live-streamed concert in December 2024. The punishment was carried out in Qom, and the court also imposed a two-year travel ban and a two-year ban on artistic activities for the individuals involved.
